description: Switches the page visibility for end users without deleting its configuration. `action = "published"` makes it reachable via slug/domain, `"unpublished"` hides it.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: status_page_publish
title: Publish or unpublish status page
